# About INFUSE

## Project Description

**INFUSE** (**IN**tegrating **F**unctional annotations into m**U**lti-ancestry fine-mapping via **S**um of single **E**ffect model) is a statistical genetics software package for fine-mapping causal variants from GWAS summary statistics across multiple ancestry populations. INFUSE is built on the Sum of Single Effects (SuSiE) regression framework and extends it to handle:

- Joint modeling of multiple ancestries with ancestry-specific LD matrices
- Annotation-informed prior probabilities for causal variant prioritization
- Optional ancestry weighting to reflect sample size or study design differences

INFUSE is implemented in R with performance-critical components written in C++.

## Citation

> Chen G, et al. INFUSE: INtegrating Functional annotations into mUlti-ancestry fine-mapping via Sum of single Effect model. *Manuscript in preparation*, 2026.

A BibTeX entry will be provided upon publication.

---

## Related Work and Software

INFUSE builds upon and is related to the following methods:

- **SuSiE** ([Wang et al., 2020](https://doi.org/10.1111/rssb.12388)) — the single-ancestry Sum of Single Effects fine-mapping model
- **MESuSiE** ([Gao et al., 2024](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-023-01604-7)) — multi-ancestry extension of SuSiE for shared causal signals
